goal: Continue versioned AEP migration validation using JSON truth sources and batched matrix runs.
operating_rules: JSON is the source of truth; Markdown is historical reference or generated view.
Run validation in batches, then update JSON once per batch.
Do not update cockpit.md, index.md, or history.md for each validation slice.
Do not create one commit per small matrix result; batch evidence commits only when a coherent batch is complete.
Keep raw matrix outputs under tmp/ and reference them from coverage JSON.
Use markdown rendering only when a human-readable view is needed.

policy_decisions.decision: The matrix command does not need an upgrade for AE host-open fanout; use existing -ae-open, -ae-versions, and -max-ae-open-cases flags.
policy_decisions.default_action: Use representative host-open evidence by capability. Broader all-host fanout is optional escalation, not the default validation path.
policy_decisions.endpoint_rule: When target-bound direct AE2020 and AE2025 host-open checks pass for the same capability, AE2021-AE2024 may be marked inferred_by_endpoint, not direct_verified.

tooling.purpose: Read coverage JSON host_open_status values and generate a chunked endpoint host-open gap audit under tmp/. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.

Read a matrix JSON artifact and update one coverage record in versioned-aep-migration-coverage.json. Go command is primary and preserves unknown coverage record fields; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.

Validate coverage JSON totals, host-open policy, declared ledgers, and recipe coverage against referenced matrix artifacts. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.

Validate current JSON references, frozen Markdown paths, tooling scripts, matrix gates, standalone verify gate, host-open gap audit, and coverage batch entries. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.

Run the JSON-first migration checkpoint: current JSON, coverage JSON, rendered summary JSON, summary validation, host-open gap audit, optional Go coverage-batch sync replay, and diff check. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility and for legacy matrix-rerun orchestration.
tooling.run_coverage_batch_matrices_command: go run ./cmd/aepregistry checkpoint -root . -current registry/versioned_aep_migration_current.json -coverage <temp coverage copy> -summary tmp/migration_coverage_summary.json -out tmp/registry_checkpoint_with_batch.json -include-coverage-batch -run-coverage-batch-matrices

tooling.purpose: List coverage batches, validate existing batch artifacts, optionally sync an explicit coverage candidate, and explicitly rerun batch matrices from current JSON. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.
tooling.sync_command: go run ./cmd/aepregistry coverage-batch -root . -current registry/versioned_aep_migration_current.json -coverage <temp coverage copy> -out tmp/registry_coverage_batch.json -batch-id all-current-writer-coverage -skip-run -sync
tooling.run_command: go run ./cmd/aepregistry coverage-batch -root . -current registry/versioned_aep_migration_current.json -coverage <temp coverage copy> -out tmp/registry_coverage_batch.json -batch-id all-current-writer-coverage -run-matrices

tooling.purpose: Generate a temporary human-readable Markdown table from coverage JSON when needed. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.

Generate a machine-readable total/split/total coverage summary from coverage JSON by domain, recipe, writer totals, recipe version-pair outcomes, per-recipe host-open evidence, and known boundaries. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.

Validate generated coverage summary JSON totals, domain rollups, recipe index entries, recipe version-pair outcomes, and per-recipe host-open evidence against coverage JSON and matrix artifacts. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.

Query generated coverage summary JSON as machine-readable totals, domain rollups, coverage records, recipe records, or host-open evidence-level groups. Go command is primary; the PowerShell script remains as legacy compatibility.
tooling.command: go run ./cmd/aepregistry migration-summary -root . -out tmp/migration_coverage_summary.json [-totals] [-domain name] [-coverage-id id] [-recipe name] [-evidence-level level]

tooling.purpose: Run a source/target AEP verification report with profile diff, migration-report allowed differences, capability-ledger boundaries, and optional AE-open verification.
tooling.command: go run ./cmd/aepmigrate verify -source source.aep -target target.aep -target-version AE2025 -report convert_report.json -out verify_report.json
